::: {.page-intro}
<h3 style="margin-top:0;">week1_reaction_times_final.csv</h3>
<p>The <strong>cleaned</strong> Week 1 classroom data these slides are built on — the raw submissions with the recommended treatment from the <a href="week1-outliers-addendum.html" style="color:#457b9d;">Week 1 outliers addendum</a> applied: one wildly extreme trial dropped (a measurement error), the flagged-but-real trials at positions 3–10 dropped with a note (distraction, not the ability being measured), the flagged trials at positions 1–2 kept (a genuine warm-up effect). Want the unfiltered raw submissions instead? Download those from the <a href="week1-data-download.html" style="color:#457b9d;">Week 1 data page</a>.</p>

::: {.page-intro}
<h3 style="margin-top:0;">sample_student_means.csv</h3>
<p>This is the file used in Week 2's own sampling-distribution task — 1,000 simulated replays of a class like ours, built from the real, cleaned Week 1 reaction-time data above.</p>
<p>One row per (sample, student), already averaged across that student's 10 trials. The task asks you to average each sample's student means down to one number, for 1, 10, 100, then all 1,000 samples.</p>
<p>

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".data-download-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
    var url = btn.getAttribute("data-url");
    var filename = btn.getAttribute("data-filename");
    var status = btn.parentElement.nextElementSibling;
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      status.textContent = "Downloading…";
      fetch(url)
        .then(function (resp) {
          if (!resp.ok) { throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status); }
          return resp.blob();
        })
        .then(function (blob) {
          var objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          var a = document.createElement("a");
          a.href = objUrl;
          a.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          a.remove();
          URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl);
          status.textContent = "Downloaded — check your Downloads folder.";
        })
        .catch(function () {
          status.textContent = "Something went wrong — use the link below instead.";
        });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
